record.bible_text: By the rivers<WH05104> of Babylon<WH0894>, there we sat down<WH03427><WTH8804>, yea, we wept<WH01058><WTH8804>, when we remembered<WH02142><WTH8800> Zion<WH06726>.
We hanged<WH08518><WTH8804> our harps<WH03658> upon the willows<WH06155> in the midst<WH08432> thereof.

For there they that carried us away captive<WH07617><WTH8802> required<WH07592><WTH8804> of us a song<WH01697><WH07892>; and they that wasted<WH08437> us <FI>required of us<Fi> mirth<WH08057>, <FI>saying<Fi> , Sing<WH07891><WTH8798> us <FI>one<Fi> of the songs<WH07892> of Zion<WH06726>. <RF>a song: Heb. the words of a song<Rf> <RF>wasted...: Heb. laid us on heaps<Rf>
How shall we sing<WH07891><WTH8799> the LORD'S<WH03068> song<WH07892> in a strange<WH05236> land<WH0127>? <RF>strange...: Heb. land of a stranger?<Rf>
If I forget<WH07911><WTH8799> thee, O Jerusalem<WH03389>, let my right hand<WH03225> forget<WH07911><WTH8799> <FI>her cunning<Fi> .

If I do not remember<WH02142><WTH8799> thee, let my tongue<WH03956> cleave<WH01692><WTH8799> to the roof of my mouth<WH02441>; if I prefer<WH05927><WTH8686> not Jerusalem<WH03389> above my chief<WH07218> joy<WH08057>. <RF>my chief...: Heb. the head of my joy<Rf><CM>

Remember<WH02142><WTH8798>, O LORD<WH03068>, the children<WH01121> of Edom<WH0123> in the day<WH03117> of Jerusalem<WH03389>; who said<WH0559><WTH8802>, Rase<WH06168><WTH8761> <FI>it<Fi> , rase<WH06168><WTH8761> <FI>it, even<Fi> to the foundation<WH03247> thereof. <RF>Rase it: Heb. Make bare<Rf>

O daughter<WH01323> of Babylon<WH0894>, who art to be destroyed<WH07703><WTH8803>; happy<WH0835> <FI>shall he be<Fi> , that rewardeth<WH07999><WTH8762> thee as thou hast served<WH01580><WTH8804><WH01576> us. <RF>destroyed: Heb. wasted<Rf> <RF>rewardeth...: Heb. recompenseth unto thee thy deed which thou didst to us<Rf>
Happy<WH0835> <FI>shall he be<Fi> , that taketh<WH0270><WTH8799> and dasheth<WH05310><WTH8765> thy little ones<WH05768> against the stones<WH05553>. <RF>the stones: Heb. the rock<Rf><CM>
